messages.subject: Are there any simple examples of custom outputs?
parts:
Hello,

I'm hoping to find some simple examples of how to extend Shiny with a custom output. I'm ultimately trying to build some custom outputs using d3.js. 

I found the tutorial page a little lacking – I still don't know exactly where to start. A simple example would be helpful.

Thanks.
